verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer can be customized: custom rules give explicit review guidelines and comment exclusions say where the agent should not comment, and these customizations appear as a pricing-tier feature. Nothing shows the configuration lives in a versioned file in the repo, and nothing documents path filters, per-path instructions or review profiles. Missing for 10: in-repo versioned config file, path-based filters, per-path instructions, review profiles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
